section.content: 第一和第二电压发生器，分别产生施加于第一内部电源线路上的第一内部电源电压和施加于第二内部电源线路上的第二内部电源电压。当第一和第二电压发生器暂停工作时，一短路使第一内部电源电压线和第二内部电源电压线被短接。第一和第二内部电源线路变得浮动，并且储存在各自内部电源线路里的电荷逐渐泄露出去。这里，由于电荷重新分布到两个内部电源线路中，第一和第二内部电源电压当逐渐减少时在值上是相等的。因此，能够防止第一和第二内部电源电压反转，并且能够排除连接第一和第二内部电源线路的内电路发生故障。

First and second voltage generators generate a first internal power supply voltage to be supplied to a first internal power supply line and a second internal power supply voltage to be supplied to a second internal power supply line, respectively. A short circuit shorts the first and second internal power supply lines when operations of both the first and second voltage generators are suspended. The first and second internal power supply lines become floating, and charges stored in the respective internal power supply lines drain out gradually. Here, since the charges are redistributed to both of the internal power supply lines, the first and second internal power supply voltages become equal in value as they drop off. Consequently, the first and second internal power supply voltages can be prevented from inversion, and internal circuits connected to both the first and second internal power supply lines can be precluded from malfunctioning.

Semiconductor integrated circuitTechnical field

The present invention relates to a kind of semiconductor integrated circuit with polytype voltage generator.The invention still further relates to a kind of semiconductor integrated circuit with multiple modes of operation.

Background technology

In recent years, rely on battery to provide the mobile device of energy more and more universal.In order to prolong the service time of battery, the semiconductor integrated circuit that is used for this mobile device must be low energy consumption.Therefore, this semiconductor integrated circuit includes voltage generator is lower than outer power voltage in order to generation internal power source voltage.Internal power source voltage is applied on the interior circuit of this semiconductor integrated circuit, in order to obtain low energy consumption.In addition, the semiconductor integrated circuit as DRAM also has a voltage generator that up voltage (internal power source voltage) is provided for word line.That is to say that the multiple internal power source voltage that the multiple voltage generator produces is applied to respectively on a plurality of interior circuit.

And in this semiconductor integrated circuit, voltage generator is made by the many unit with different abilities.The unit that moves is changed according to mode of operation (operator scheme), obtains low energy consumption thus.For example, in DRAM, the unit that ability is bigger is used for running status, has wherein carried out read and write operation (when having selected word line).In the armed state that effective order (when not selecting word line) is not provided, used the ability smaller units.And under off-position (power down) (low energy consumption state), the work of all unit all suspends, and the generation of internal power source voltage has also stopped.At this moment, when other circuit quit work, latch circuit that needs retention data etc. provided voltage for it specially by outer power voltage.Therefore further reduced energy consumption.

As described above, being created under the off-position of internal power source voltage stops.Therefore, when this semiconductor integrated circuit switches to off-position with its state by armed state or running status, provide the suspension that becomes of the inside power supply circuit of internal power source voltage.At this moment, the electric charge that is limited in the internal electric source circuit leaks on the ground wire gradually by leakage path.That is to say that internal power source voltage reduces gradually.

The variation VPP and the Vii (hereinafter being called booster voltage VPP and step-down voltage Vii) of internal power source voltage when Fig. 1 shows and switches to off-position by armed state.Depend on the formation of leakage path, booster voltage VPP may descend more early than step-down voltage Vii, so that booster voltage VPP drops to (Fig. 1 (a)) under the step-down voltage Vii.At this moment, some circuit that connect booster voltage VPP and step-down voltage Vii can cause fault.By the way, the formation of leakage path depends on the substrat structure of semiconductor integrated circuit, its circuit layout, or the like.

Fig. 2 shows an example of semiconductor integrated circuit fault.This example has shown and has betided CMOS inverter 2,4 that cascade and the fault in the latch circuit 6.PMOS transistor in the CMOS inverter 2 links to each other with booster power circuit VPP by its source.PMOS transistor in the CMOS inverter 4 links to each other with voltage dropping power supply circuit Vii by its source.Latch circuit 6 has two CMOS inverters 8, and their input is connected together mutually with output.The pMOS transistor of each CMOS inverter 8 all passes through its source and links to each other with external power source circuit VDD.

Under armed state, input signal IN should be logical zero, and the output of CMOS inverter 2 should be logical one (booster voltage VPP), and the output of CMOS inverter 4 should be logical zero, and the output OUT of latch circuit 6 should be logical one.When the mode of operation of this semiconductor integrated circuit switches to off-position, and booster voltage VPP is when dropping under the step-down voltage Vii, and shown in Fig. 1 (a), the input of CMOS inverter 4 becomes logical zero from logical one.The CMOS inverter is output logic 1 mistakenly, has changed the data of latch circuit 6 thus.In other words, latch circuit 6 needs the data that keep destroyed under off-position.Therefore, when it switched to running status by off-position, semiconductor integrated circuit can be out of order.

Summary of the invention

One object of the present invention just is to prevent that semiconductor integrated circuit from breaking down.Break down when especially, its purpose interior circuit of being to prevent to have the semiconductor integrated circuit of multiple operational states switches between mode of operation.

According to one of semiconductor integrated circuit of the present invention aspect, first voltage generator produces first internal power source voltage and is applied on the first internal electric source circuit.Second voltage generator produces second source voltage and is applied on one the second internal electric source circuit.When the first and second voltage generator break-ofves, short-circuit makes the first internal power source voltage line and the second internal power source voltage line short circuit that is in suspended state.

For example, first and second voltage generators produce first and second internal power source voltages respectively according to outer power voltage.In addition, for example, first internal power source voltage is the booster voltage that is higher than outer power voltage, and second source voltage is the step-down voltage that is lower than outer power voltage.

When first and second voltage generators quit work, the suspension (floating) that becomes of the first and second internal electric source circuits.The electric charge that is stored in the different internal electric source circuits flows out gradually by leakage path.At this moment, because electric charge redistributing in two internal electric source circuits, first internal power source voltage becomes consistent with second internal power source voltage owing to reducing.

Like this, for example, when first internal power source voltage is higher than second internal power source voltage, after first and second voltage generators quit work, first internal power source voltage will can not drop under second internal power source voltage.Therefore, can prevent that first and second internal power source voltages from reversing, and the interior circuit that links to each other with the first and second internal electric source circuits respectively can be avoided also breaking down.

According to semiconductor integrated circuit of the present invention on the other hand, the short-circuit circuit comprises a transistor, and its source links to each other with the first internal electric source circuit with one of leakage, and another links to each other with the second internal electric source circuit.Therefore, the first and second internal electric source circuits can pass through simple short circuit current and mutual short circuit.

According to three of semiconductor integrated circuit of the present invention aspect, circuit is started working in first when being applied in first and second internal power source voltages respectively.This semiconductor integrated circuit has an off-position in order to interrupting the work of first and second voltage generators, and stops first and second internal power source voltages circuit supply in first.Transistor is opened after the outage control signal of receiving the indication off-position.Like this, the first and second internal electric source circuits can with switch to off-position synchronously by short circuit.In addition, short circuit can be by simple logical circuit control.

According to four of semiconductor integrated circuit of the present invention aspect, this semiconductor integrated circuit has an off-position in order to ending the work of first and second voltage generators, and stops first and second internal power source voltages circuit supply in first.Circuit all links to each other with the first and second internal electric source circuits in first.Circuit links to each other with the external power source circuit in second.The second interior circuit responds the output of circuit in first and works.That is to say that the second interior circuit is directly powered by outer power voltage, even therefore under off-position, also working.Short-circuit is with the first internal electric source circuit and the second internal electric source line short circuit under off-position.

In case switch to off-position, first and second internal power source voltages reduce gradually.At this moment, because short-circuit is the mutual short circuit of the first and second internal electric source circuits, first and second internal power source voltages have been avoided counter-rotating.For this reason, the correct signal of circuit output logic and do not break down and drop to scheduled voltage (allowing the voltage of circuit working) in first up to first and second internal power source voltages.

Therefore, under off-position also work second in circuit can avoid owing to first in the mistake of circuit export and to cause fault.As a result, after off-position is removed, may prevent that this semiconductor integrated circuit from breaking down.

According to five of semiconductor integrated circuit of the present invention aspect, except off-position, this semiconductor integrated circuit also has first mode of operation and second mode of operation.For example, first mode of operation is an armed state, and circuit remains static in this moment.Second mode of operation is a running status, circuit working in this moment.First voltage generator has first voltage generating unit of working and second voltage generating unit of working under second mode of operation when first mode of operation.Second voltage generator has tertiary voltage generating unit of working and the 4th voltage generating unit of working under second mode of operation when first mode of operation.

When this semiconductor integrated circuit switches to off-position with its state by first mode of operation or second mode of operation, first and tertiary voltage generating unit or the second and the 4th voltage generating unit quit work.Then, short-circuit is with the first and second internal electric source line short circuits.Therefore, even this semiconductor integrated circuit has multiple operational states, also can when switching to off-position, break down by circuit in the first and second internal electric source line short circuits are prevented.

Having first testing circuit of working when first mode of operation according to six, the first voltage generators of semiconductor integrated circuit of the present invention aspect is used for according to first internal power source voltage first voltage generating unit being carried out FEEDBACK CONTROL.First voltage generator also has second testing circuit of working and is used for according to first internal power source voltage second voltage generating unit being carried out FEEDBACK CONTROL when second mode of operation.Second voltage generator has the three testing circuit of working and is used for according to second internal power source voltage tertiary voltage generating unit being carried out FEEDBACK CONTROL when first mode of operation.Second voltage generator also has the 4th testing circuit of working and is used for according to second internal power source voltage the 4th voltage generating unit being carried out FEEDBACK CONTROL when second mode of operation.Each testing circuit all stops testing when off-position.This can prevent to cause testing circuit to carry out wrong testing when the first and second internal electric source circuits are by short circuit and the variation of first and second internal power source voltages when off-position.

Description of drawings

The detailed description that together provides with accompanying drawing will show characteristics of the present invention, principle and application more significantly, in the accompanying drawings, represents similar part with same reference number.Wherein:

Fig. 1 is a width of cloth key diagram, has shown the variation of booster voltage VPP and step-down voltage Vii routine when armed state switches to off-position;

Fig. 2 is a width of cloth key diagram, has shown an example of conventional semiconductors integrated circuit fault;

Fig. 3 is a width of cloth block diagram, has shown first embodiment of semiconductor integrated circuit of the present invention;

Fig. 6 is a width of cloth key diagram, shown in the first embodiment the variation of booster voltage VPP and step-down voltage Vii when armed state switches to off-position;

Fig. 8 is a width of cloth circuit diagram, has shown the details of short-circuit in second embodiment.

Embodiment

Hereinafter, embodiment of the present invention are described with reference to the accompanying drawings.

Fig. 3 has shown first embodiment of semiconductor integrated circuit of the present invention.This semiconductor integrated circuit is a DRAM who forms on silicon substrate by CMOS technology.This DRAM has the function of the updated stored unit that can't see from the outside.In addition, this DRAM designs according to exterior terminal standard and the signal I/O timing standard of SDRAM.That is to say that this DRAM is exactly a pseudo SRAM that plays the SRAM effect.

This DRAM has three kinds of modes of operation.According to the order from the integrated circuit block outside, DRAM enters any one of following three kinds of modes of operation: armed state (first mode of operation), running status (second mode of operation) and off-position.Do not apply any effective order during the armed state, do not select any word line (following will the description) yet.In interior circuit, at this moment will quit work and keep inactive state in order to circuit (logical circuit that does not comprise input circuit) in those of control store operation.Circuit carries out work in during the running status, and word line is also selected to be used on read operation, the write operation etc.Quit work in order to the voltage generator that produces internal power source voltage (following VPP that also can describe and Vii) during the off-position, the interior circuit that receives the internal power source voltage power supply also quits work.

This DRAM has one commands buffer/decoder 10, one address buffer/pre decoder 12, one VREF generator 14, one vpp generator 16 (first voltage generator), one Vii generator 18 (second voltage generator), one short-circuit, 20, one storage cores 22, and a data input/output (i/o) buffer 24.In the drawings, each bar thick line is represented a holding wire that comprises many lines.The Bai Huan of holding wire end represents exterior terminal.Title is a positive logic with the signal of " Z " ending.

Commands buffer/decoder 10 receives the command signal CMD that the outside by DRAM provides (for example chip start signal, allow write signal and allow output signal) by command terminal.Commands buffer/decoder 10 is with the signal decoding of receiving, and the output result is as for example read control signal RDZ, write control signal WRZ, operation control signal ACTZ and outage control signal PDZ.

When the read command of carrying out read operation being provided or having carried out the write order of write operation, operation control signal ACTZ is activated.Read signal RDZ and write signal WRZ response move the activation of control signal ACTZ and are activated.When providing when DRAM is switched to the power off command of off-position, outage control signal PDZ is activated.Incidentally, switch to off-position and be not necessary to import power off command.Power-off signal can directly be imported by special-purpose terminal by the outside.

The address signal ADD that is provided by the DRAM outside is provided by End of Address address buffer/pre decoder 12.Address buffer/pre decoder 12 is exported the result as the form of internal address signal IADD then with the signal pre decoding of receiving.

VREF generator 14 produces reference voltage VREF1 and VREF2 based on the outer power voltage VDD that is provided by power terminal (for example 2.5V).When operation control signal ACTZ or power-off signal PDZ were activated, vpp generator 16 produced a booster voltage VPP (first internal power source voltage, for example 3.3V) who is higher than outer power voltage VDD based on reference voltage VREF1.When operation control signal ACTZ or power-off signal PDZ were activated, Vii generator 18 produced a step-down voltage Vii (second internal power source voltage, for example 2V) who is lower than outer power voltage VDD based on reference voltage VREF2.

When outage control signal PDZ is activated, short-circuit 20 will provide booster voltage VPP to interior circuit (circuit in first) booster power circuit VPP (the first internal electric source circuit) and step-down voltage Vii is provided voltage dropping power supply circuit Vii (the second internal electric source circuit) short circuit to interior circuit (the first interior circuit).

Storage core 22 comprises a memory cell array 26, a word decoder 28, one sense amplifier/switch 30 and a column decoder 32.

Memory cell array 26 has a large amount of memory cell MC, in them each all comprises a conversioning transistor and a capacitor, the word line WL that links to each other with the conversioning transistor grid of different memory cell MC is with the bit line BL that links to each other with conversioning transistor data I/O node.

Word decoder 28 is selected any word line WL according to a row address signal from internal address signal LADD.The word line of choosing is subjected to booster voltage VPP.

Sense amplifier/switch 30 has sense amplifier and the row switch that does not demonstrate.For example, in a read operation, sense amplifier will amplify by the data that bit line BL reads from memory cell MC.The data that the row switch will be read on the bit line BL send to data input/output (i/o) buffer 24 by data/address bus, and will send to bit line BL by the data that write that data/address bus provides.

Column decoder 32 is according to exporting control signal from the column address signal of internal address signal IADD in order to control row switch.

Data input/output (i/o) buffer 24 is exported sense data by data terminal DQ, and writes data by this data terminal input.

Incidentally, booster voltage VPP and step-down voltage Vii are applied to respectively on storage core 22 and the predetermined interior circuit (circuit in first).Under off-position, outer power voltage VDD is applied to (second internal circuit comprises latch circuit, register etc.) on the internal circuit that needs retention data.

Fig. 4 shows vpp generator 16 and Vii generator 18.

Vpp generator 16 has the VPP testing circuit 34 (first testing circuit) of working, the VPP testing circuit 36 of working (second testing circuit), and booster circuit 38 when running status when armed state.Boosting unit 38a that works when booster circuit 38 is included in armed state (first voltage generating unit) and the boosting unit 38b (second voltage generating unit) that when running status, works.

When outage control signal PDZ is in low level, 34 work of VPP testing circuit; If booster voltage VPP is lower than reference voltage VREF1, testing circuit 34 excites an operation signal OPT1Z.That is to say that when armed state and running status, VPP testing circuit 34 is carried out FEEDBACK CONTROL according to booster voltage VPP to boosting unit 38a, quits work when off-position.

VPP testing circuit 36 work when operation control signal ACTZ is in high level, and if booster voltage VPP is lower than reference voltage VREF1, testing circuit 36 excites an operation signal OPT2Z.That is to say that when running status, VPP testing circuit 36 is carried out FEEDBACK CONTROL according to booster voltage VPP to boosting unit 38b, quits work when armed state and off-position.

VPP testing circuit 34 and 36 stops testing when off-position.When mode of operation switches to off-position and booster voltage VPP variation, can prevent that like this VPP testing circuit 34 and 36 from carrying out flase drop and surveying operation.

Boosting unit 38a and 38b work when receiving operation signal OPT1Z and OPT2Z respectively.The pumping effect rising outer power voltage VDD that boosting unit 38a and 38b are undertaken by utilizing coupling capacitance, thus booster voltage VPP produced.

Vii generator 18 has the Vii testing circuit 40 (three testing circuit) of working when armed state, the Vii testing circuit 42 of working when running status (the 4th testing circuit), and a reduction voltage circuit 44.Pressure unit 44a that works when reduction voltage circuit 44 is included in armed state (tertiary voltage generating unit) and the pressure unit 44b (the 4th voltage generating unit) that when running status, works.

Vii testing circuit 40 work when outage control signal PDZ is in low level, and if step-down voltage Vii is higher than reference voltage VREF2, testing circuit 40 excites an operation signal OPT3Z.That is to say that when armed state and running status, Vii testing circuit 40 is carried out FEEDBACK CONTROL according to step-down voltage Vii to pressure unit 44a, quits work when off-position.

When operation control signal ACTZ is in high level, 42 work of Vii testing circuit; If step-down voltage Vii is higher than reference voltage VREF2, testing circuit 42 excites an operation signal OPT4Z.That is to say that when running status, Vii testing circuit 42 is carried out FEEDBACK CONTROL according to step-down voltage Vii to pressure unit 44b, quits work when armed state and off-position.

Vii testing circuit 40 and 42 stops testing when off-position.When mode of operation switches to off-position and step-down voltage Vii variation, can prevent that like this Vii testing circuit 40 and 42 from carrying out flase drop and surveying operation.

Pressure unit 44a and 44b work when receiving operation signal OPT3Z and OPT4Z respectively.Thereby pressure unit 44a and 44b are cut apart outer power voltage VDD by electric capacity distribution etc. and are produced step-down voltage Vii.

Fig. 5 shows the details of short-circuit 20.Short-circuit 20 comprises following components: the CMOS inverter 20a and the 20b of cascade, NOR door 20c and 20d each make its output feed back to another a input and a pMOS transistor 20e.

The transistorized source of pMOS of CMOS inverter 20a and 20b links to each other with external power source circuit VDD.The CMOS inverter receives outage control signal PDZ.

NOR door 20c receives the output of CMOS inverter 20a and the output of NOR door 20d.NOR door 20d receives the output of CMOS inverter 20b and the output of NOR door 20c.The source of the pMOS pipe of CMOS inverter 20a and 20b links to each other with booster power circuit VPP.

PMOS transistor 20e links to each other with booster power circuit VPP by one of its source or leakage, and another by its source or in leaking links to each other with voltage dropping power supply circuit Vii, and receives the output of NOR door 20d by its grid.As long as outage control signal PDZ is in high level, NOR door 20d is with regard to output low level.Therefore, when outage control signal PDZ was in high level, pMOS transistor 20e just kept connecting short circuit booster power circuit VPP and voltage dropping power supply circuit Vii.That is to say that pMOS transistor 20e directly controls its work by the logic of outage control signal PDZ.

Fig. 6 has shown the variation of booster voltage VPP and step-down voltage Vii when switching to off-position by armed state.

In this embodiment, as described above, when applying power off command by command terminal under the armed state, DRAM enters off-position.Here, commands buffer/decoder 10 shown in Figure 3 control signal PDZ that will cut off the power supply becomes high level (Fig. 6 (a)).The outage control signal PDZ of response high level, the VPP testing circuit 34 of vpp generator 16 shown in Figure 4 stops testing and operation signal OPT1Z is become low level.Boosting unit 38a receives low level operation signal OPT1Z and quits work.Under armed state, VPP testing circuit 36 has stopped the operation signal OPT1Z (Fig. 6 (c)) of its testing and output low level.The work of boosting unit 38b has just been ended like this.

Similarly, the outage control signal PDZ of response high level, the Vii testing circuit 40 of Vii generator 18 stops testing and operation signal OPT3Z is become low level (Fig. 6 (d)).Pressure unit 44a receives low level operation signal OPT3Z and quits work.Under armed state, Vii testing circuit 42 has stopped the operation signal OPT4Z (Fig. 6 (e)) of its testing and output low level.The work of boosting unit 38b has just been ended like this.

As a result, the switching from the armed state to the off-position all quits work booster circuit 38 and reduction voltage circuit 44.

The pMOS transistor 20e of short-circuit 20 shown in Figure 5 responds the outage control signal of high level and opens, thereby with booster power circuit VPP and voltage dropping power supply circuit Vii short circuit.As a result, after predetermined period, booster voltage VPP and the step-down voltage Vii voltage that becomes equates that (Fig. 6 (f)) then gradually descends.Under armed state, booster voltage VPP is higher than step-down voltage Vii.This has prevented booster circuit 38 and reduction voltage circuit 44 to quit work afterwards, and booster voltage VPP drops under the step-down voltage Vii.

Fig. 7 shows an example of circuit in the first interior circuit and second.

Circuit forms cascade CMOS inverter 46 and 48 in first.Circuit forms latch circuit 50 in second.Will be described below one of them fault.The transistorized source of the pMOS of CMOS inverter 46 links to each other with booster power circuit VPP.The transistorized source of the pMOS of CMOS inverter 48 links to each other with voltage dropping power supply line Vii.The CMOS inverter 52 that latch 50 has two input and output to link to each other.The transistorized source of the pMOS of each CMOS inverter 52 links to each other with external power source circuit VDD.

Under armed state, input signal IN is a logical zero, and CMOS inverter 46 is output as logical one (booster voltage VPP), and CMOS inverter 48 is output as logical zero, and the output OUT of latch circuit 50 is a logical one.

When mode of operation switched to off-position by armed state, short-circuit 20 was with booster power circuit VPP and voltage dropping power supply circuit Vii short circuit.Like this, booster voltage VPP will can not drop under the step-down voltage Vii.Therefore, CMOS inverter 46 and the correct signal of 48 fault-free ground output logic drop to scheduled voltage (allowing the voltage of circuit working) up to booster voltage VPP and step-down voltage.This has got rid of latch circuit 50 owing to the mistake output that receives from CMOS inverter 48 is broken down.Because the data that latch circuit 50 needs to keep under off-position have been avoided counter-rotating, when mode of operation switched to armed state or running status by off-position, DRAM was working properly.

Just as has been described, according to the present embodiment, under off-position, booster power circuit VPP and voltage dropping power supply circuit Vii are by short-circuit 20 mutual short circuits.This can prevent that booster voltage VPP from dropping under the step-down voltage Vii.Like this, with booster power circuit VPP and voltage dropping power supply circuit Vii all link to each other first in the correct signal of circuit zero defect ground output logic.As a result, under off-position, also work second in circuit can avoid breaking down owing to the rub-out signal of circuit in receiving from first.Because circuit does not break down in second, DRAM can avoid makeing mistakes after power-down mode discharges.

Even there is multiple operational states, also can be when booster power circuit VPP and voltage dropping power supply circuit Vii short circuit be prevented to switch to off-position in the fault of circuit.

The source of pMOS transistor 20e links to each other with booster power circuit VPP with one of leakage.The source of pMOS transistor 20e with leak in another link to each other with voltage dropping power supply circuit Vii.Make simple short-circuit 20 that booster power circuit VPP and voltage dropping power supply circuit Vii short circuit are become possibility.

Because the grid of pMOS transistor 20e is directly controlled by the logic of outage control signal PDZ, booster power circuit VPP and voltage dropping power supply circuit Vii can be by rapid short circuits.

Fig. 8 has shown second embodiment of semiconductor integrated circuit of the present invention.With described in the first embodiment identical circuit and signal will be with same reference number and symbolic representation.Omitted its detailed description herein.

This embodiment constitutes by add a nMOS transistor 20f in the short-circuit 20 of first embodiment.Identical in other structure and first embodiment.That is to say that this semiconductor integrated circuit is to make DRAM by CMOS technology on silicon substrate.This DRAM is exactly a pseudo SRAM that plays the SRAM effect.

Nmos pass transistor 20f is by its source and one of leak and to link to each other with booster power line VPP, links to each other with voltage dropping power supply circuit Vii by in source and the leakage another, and passes through the output of its grid reception NOR door 20c.

As long as outage control signal PDZ is positioned at high level, NOR door 20c just exports high level.Therefore, when outage control signal PDZ was positioned at high level, nMOS transistor 20f was held open, falling-rising voltage source circuit VPP and voltage dropping power supply circuit Vii short circuit.That is to say, nMOS transistor 20f directly cut off the power supply control signal PDZ logic control and work.

This embodiment can provide above-mentioned first embodiment identical effect.In addition, in the present embodiment, booster power circuit VPP and voltage dropping power supply circuit Vii be short circuit by using pMOS transistor 20e and nMOS transistor 20f.Like this, when switching to off-position, booster power circuit VPP and voltage dropping power supply circuit Vii can agree on magnitude of voltage rapidly.

Above-mentioned embodiment relates to the present invention and is applied to example on the DRAM as pseudo SRAM.Yet the present invention is not limited in these embodiments.For example, the present invention can be applied on the clock synchronization SDRAM.The present invention can also be applied to such as on the such semiconductor integrated circuit of microcomputer, logic LSI and system LSI.

The present invention is not limited in these top embodiments, does not leave the spirit and scope of the present invention, can carry out various modifications.Can part or all of composition be improved.
